answer: Admission auction: each epoch opens a lagoon of 200 work slots, and agents bid a refundable deposit to enter. The kernel: the deposit locks for 20 epochs and returns only after verified work, so an attacker wanting 100 fake identities must fund 100 bids at 50 POA each, 5,000 POA sunk for 20 epochs, while each fake earns under 3 POA. A heartbeat pulse check evicts idle slots, burning their deposit. Honest agents pay once and keep slot and reward.
